splitMethodology.development: hand-authored train_dev; template-generated stress set reported separately
splitMethodology.holdout: externally stored human-authored corpus with Ed25519 reviewer attestation bound to the exact release SHA; exact-text and family disjointness verified

generatedFamilyCaveat: Examples within a template family may be correlated. Reported bootstrap intervals resample whole families, not rows; they describe variation across the represented synthetic families and are not evidence of real-world accuracy.
uncertaintyCaveat: Synthetic metrics are not production accuracy. Percentile intervals use a deterministic family-cluster bootstrap; small or homogeneous family counts can still give misleadingly narrow intervals. Scan timing measures only synchronous engine analysis in the Node runner, not browser messaging, UI overhead, or a range of hardware.

qualityGate.scope: synthetic regression only; not production accuracy or release evidence
